scope: Ordinary authenticated HTTPS operator commands for provisioning and revoking an exact registered SFTP route

contract.authority: Current root admin and connections_manage with an existing exact active SFTP source reference and an exact eligible same-partner recipient.

first_failure.result: The router returned 405 before the endpoint was installed.

targeted_race_tests.scope: Authentication, missing operation key, duplicate or aliased fields, invented credential selectors, body bounds, browser origin and CSRF guards.

real_https_and_cli.environment: Go 1.27.4 darwin/arm64 with race detection, real PostgreSQL 16.15, Apple curl 8.7.1 and stock OpenSSH 10.5p1 on task-owned loopback
assertions: A recipient without administration cannot provision or revoke a route. Stale recipient authority and unrelated partner actors are refused.
An HTTP provision creates one exact registration with the assigned actor as owner and the operator as event author. The recipient authority revision and SSH pins match the approved source.
HTTP and CLI both recover the original provision receipt. Changed meaning under the same key is refused. An unauthorized raw projection and a standalone event cannot bypass its receipt.
HTTP reads keep the original and assigned connection actor-private. The assigned recipient sees the exact pinned route.
The stock receiver independently reads back the approved owned bytes. HTTP revocation preserves its own receipt and fences the already queued run before any new receiver session.

static: OpenAPI path, statuses and local references
remaining: Native Linux qualification and browser operator UI proof remain open. Additional connection profiles, process-death recovery and the full product gates stay open.
